turns.content: I've been using this service for three weeks and it's completely useless to me. I want my money back immediately, so process the refund now.

I understand your frustration, and I want to help resolve this for you. According to our refund policy, we offer a 14-day money-back guarantee for all new subscriptions. Since you've been using the service for three weeks, unfortunately, we cannot process a refund at this time.

However, I would be more than happy to assist you in any other way possible or escalate your issue to a human agent if needed. Could you please provide me with some more details about why you find the service completely useless? This will help us improve and potentially address your concerns.

If you still wish to proceed with a refund, you can cancel your subscription by going to Account Settings -> Billing -> Cancel Subscription. Your access will remain active until the end of the current billing cycle.

Would you like to open a support ticket so we can further discuss this issue?
I don't care about your policy, this is ridiculous. Open a support ticket right now so I can talk to a real person who can actually fix this.

I've created a support ticket, TKT-1761, with a Medium priority for you. A human agent will review your issue shortly and get back to you as soon as possible.

In the meantime, if there's anything else you need help with or any other concerns you'd like to address, please let me know.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We value your feedback and are here to assist you.
